doc_summary: `native_screen_render_post`, the point of `ScreenEvent.Render.Post`: a native mod draws over the open screen after it and its tooltips, given its id, the server-opened menu's vanilla type (`menu`) and title, its container panel, its slot count, the mouse in GUI pixels and the partial tick (`NativeScreenView`). Every container, station and mod window draws on the inventory screen and so reports `inventory`: tell them apart by `menu` and `title` (None on a window the client opened) and by `slots`. It does not fire on the title screen, nor for the prompts, books and sign editors drawn over gameplay after it. Bundles that use it need "hooks": @API:screen_render_post@.
